ruleset.$noRequiredStatusChecksNote: UMB-048 item 4's caveat, encoded here rather than only in prose: this ruleset deliberately carries NO required_status_checks rule. The red-fix (.github commit da15148) gates every skeleton CI step — and the whole CodeQL job — on hashFiles(<script>) != '', so a step can legitimately SKIP rather than run on a freshly scaffolded repo with no scripts/ yet. A required-status-check ruleset binds on the JOB's own name (e.g. 'gate', 'all-green'), which still reports success when every step inside it skips — so naming a job here would be SAFE by that same property. The caveat is real anyway: a required check must name a job that ALWAYS EXISTS in the workflow run (never a job gated out entirely by an `if:` at the job level, e.g. CodeQL's `analyze` job) or the ruleset blocks every push forever waiting for a check that never reports. Where a room DOES want required checks, name 'gate'/'all-green' (job-level `if:` is absent, only its STEPS are hashFiles-gated) — never 'analyze (javascript)' from codeql.yml until that room ships real JS/TS source.
